name: 54722 · Augusta, WI
findings: ZIP 54722 (Augusta) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54722 (Augusta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54722 (Augusta) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
